title: Template: fix the BFS that visits in the wrong order

config.prompt: This BFS visits the vertices in the wrong order. Replace the faulty line with a correction.

solution.explanation: Correct. popleft takes the vertex that has waited longest, so BFS visits the closest vertices first.

feedback.7: Not quite. pop takes the newest vertex from the back, so the queue acts like a stack and BFS goes deep first. Replace it with a line that takes the vertex at the front.

hints.body: Run it in your head on a graph where A has two neighbours. Which one is visited second?
Look at the line that takes a vertex out of the queue.
pop takes from the back of the queue. BFS takes from the front.
Answer: replace v = queue.pop() with v = queue.popleft(). Every other line stays.
